annotations.title: Planning histories for up to 100 properties

description:
`property_planning_history` for up to 100 properties in one call, per-item
    outcomes (ok | no_applications | not_covered | not_found | error) in input
    order. Charged per property answered — the sum of the single calls, never
    more; not_covered rows are free.
    UK only. Costs 5 credits (5p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_planning_history_batch
title: Planning histories for up to 100 properties
